rule.gain: sum of per-fold return_pct, arm minus its control, over a half
rule.per_model_PASS: early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired verdict (15 folds) maps to pass AND both risk verdicts (Sharpe, maxDD; 15 folds) map to pass
rule.per_model_INCONCLUSIVE: control < min_control_trades, OR the arm changed trades in 0 folds, OR a mapped verdict is inconclusive
rule.switch_ADOPT: PASS on the primary model (ARO) AND PASS on at least replications_needed of GBR, GFM, MLX
rule.combination: run only if >= 2 candidates are ADOPTED: all ADOPTED levers together; if TP and TK are both adopted, TP (larger early_sum_pp) is kept
rule.candidate_ADOPT: PASS on ARO AND PASS on at least replications_needed of GBR, GFM, MLX
